latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(friends): show unread official Hydra messages in the friends window by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3084
* chore: bump version to 4.4.0 by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3075
* fix(notifications): stop cutting the custom achievement animation by @Sociable-Fish in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3042
* feat(ui): one 40px title bar, no bottom panel, and a UI consistency pass by @chubbygrannychaser in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3095
* fix(gofile): handle HTML responses from the Gofile API by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3085
* fix(torrent): keep downloads out of temp during a metadata lookup by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3070
* feat(classics): add PS4 emulation through shadPS4 by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3103
* refactor(cloud-save): generic path for disc-based emulator saves by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3104
* fix(torrent): resume paused downloads without losing peers or state by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3068
* fix(renderer): sanitize rich text with DOMPurify and restrict script sources by @chubbygrannychaser in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3110
* feat(classics): shadPS4 trophies without a key, folder prefill, PKG listing, disc region flags and Wayland capture by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3108
* Feature/rpcs3 achievements by @galinhaman in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3114
* feat(cloud-save): shadPS4 save provider (not enabled yet) by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3105
* feat(recompilation): unlock Hydra achievements from PS4 port trophies by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3115
* feat(ps4): extract PS4 PKGs for shadPS4 and the PS4 ports by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3121
* feat(recompilation): add the God of War III, Bloodborne and Shadow of the Colossus PS4 ports by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3113
* feat(game-options): polish the port icons and the General tab, add Apply update by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3125
* fix(cloud-save): keep shadPS4 saves from every version of the game by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3123
* chore(classics): point the shadPS4 setup guide card at its Work Wonders article by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3128
* feat(recompilation): add the P.T., CTR Nitro-Fueled and inFAMOUS Second Son PS4 ports by @Hachi-R in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3127
* feat(library): add custom drag-and-drop ordering, including inside collections by @Moyasee in https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/pull/3120


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/compare/v4.4.0...v4.4.1

detail.readme:
[](https://help.hydralauncher.gg)

Hydra Launcher

Hydra Launcher is an open-source gaming platform created to be the single tool that you need in order to manage your gaming library. Hydra is written in Node.js (Electron, React, Typescript) and Rust, with libtorrent providing the torrent engine.

[![build](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/hydralauncher/hydra/build.yml)](https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/actions) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/package-json/v/hydralauncher/hydra)](https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/releases) [![chocolatey](https://img.shields.io/chocolatey/v/hydralauncher.svg)](https://community.chocolatey.org/packages/hydralauncher) ![Hydra Launcher Home Page](./docs/screenshot.png)
## Features - Add games that you own to your library - Have a nice profile that shows what you are playing to your friends - Save your game progress in the cloud with Hydra Cloud - Unlock achievements - Navigate through a rich catalogue with a powerful suggestion algorithm - Discover new games that you haven't played before ## Build from source and contributing Please, refer to our Documentation pages: [docs.hydralauncher.gg](https://docs.hydralauncher.gg/getting-started) ### Local development requirements - Node.js + Yarn - Rust toolchain (for `hydra-native`) - Git and a C++ toolchain (Visual Studio C++ Build Tools on Windows, GCC/Clang on Linux, Xcode command-line tools on macOS). The native build obtains CMake and CTest automatically through vcpkg. After installing dependencies, `postinstall` now builds the Rust native addon automatically (`hydra-native/hydra-native.node`). The native build includes a Rust wrapper around pinned libtorrent. Development and packaged torrenting no longer require Python. On Windows x64 and Linux x64, the libtorrent bridge comes prebuilt from `native/torrent-bridge/prebuilt`, so installs skip compiling libtorrent through vcpkg. Other platforms build it from source. When a branch push changes `native/torrent-bridge` or `scripts/build-torrent-bridge.cjs`, the "Torrent bridge prebuilts" workflow rebuilds the binaries and commits them to that branch; until then, installs build the bridge from source. Set `HYDRA_TORRENT_BRIDGE_FROM_SOURCE=1` to always build it from source. ## Contributors ## License Hydra is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
